BL-1182 — Day-long BoB trial lifecycle — nominate, seat, assess, promote or revert (tie→cheap)
What it solves: - [2026-08-27] specifier: minted; one operating day = calendar/shift-aligned
  day locked against swarm_shift_lib in implementation notes if needed.
Approval context: Core trial loop from BoB intake. Trial window: one operating day. Promote if outranks; tie → cheapest wins (cost_class / measured cost). Record losers so they are not endlessly re-trialled without new evidence. Live runs gated by BL-1183.
BL-1182 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1182" (or "reject BL-1182 <reason>") to act.
